mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% over two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10) in periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% coincident with a housing starts contraction (HOUST) below 1,000k units signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY < -2% AND HOUST < 1000 for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10) during periods meeting the dual GDPC1/HOUST trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) falling below 3.5% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market that amplifies wage inflation and input costs, which erodes corporate margins and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10) when UNRATE < 3.5% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 0.5% for three consecutive months indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces revenue growth for cyclicals and drags the S&P 500 lower over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < previous month - 0.5% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10) during three-month INDPRO declines exceeding 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in both CPIAUCSL above 3% and FEDFUNDS above 2% for two consecutive months signals a dual shock of elevated inflation and restrictive policy, which increases uncertainty and reduces risk appetite, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 3% AND FEDFUNDS > 2% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10) when both CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS > 2% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in real personal savings (RSAFS) above the previous month by more than 2% signals elevated precautionary behavior by households, which reduces near-term consumption and corporate revenue, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > previous month + 2% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10) during periods of two consecutive months with RSAFS rising by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll employment growth (PAYEMS) acceleration above 0.5% from the prior month for two consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 0.5% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.10) when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly decline in both INDPRO and HOUST of more than 0.4% signals a broad-based contraction in manufacturing and housing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and increases recession risk, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < previous month - 0.4% AND HOUST < previous month - 0.4% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10) during periods of two consecutive months with both INDPRO and HOUST declining by more than 0.4%.
